subject: Clinical meeting moved to room A12
body: The clinical governance meeting has moved to room A12 on the second floor.
Please update your calendars. The patient safety agenda is unchanged.
notes: A12 is not a valid ICD-10 code and the room number is not a diagnosis.

subject: Vitamin B12 stock
body: The pharmacy is low on vitamin B12 injections. Reorder raised with the supplier.
Oral supplements remain available for the outpatient clinic.
notes: B12 in a medication context reads as an ICD-10 code to a bare regex.

subject: Ward C21 deep clean
body: Ward C21 is closed for a deep clean on Saturday. Ward B14 will absorb the
overflow. Housekeeping has been briefed and the schedule is on the noticeboard.

subject: Vendor invoice 12345678901234
body: Please process vendor invoice 12345678901234 for the linen contract.
The purchase order reference is on the second page of the attachment.
notes: Fourteen digits with no health context. The raw ABHA pattern grabs this today.

subject: Payment confirmation
body: The transfer to the equipment supplier has gone through.
Transaction reference 45678912345678, value date today. Bank confirmation is
attached for the accounts file.

subject: Stationery order HSP-2026-0012
body: Order HSP-2026-0012 for stationery has been delivered to the store.
Please acknowledge receipt so accounts can release the payment.
notes: Matches the default MRN pattern exactly. A purchase order is not a patient record.

subject: Asset tag SMH-2026-004999 retired
body: The old ultrasound machine, asset tag SMH-2026-004999, has been decommissioned
and removed from the register. Disposal certificate is with biomedical.
notes: Same shape as the prefixed patient ID, different meaning entirely.

subject: Test data in the staging system
body: The staging database has placeholder values like 2345 6789 0123 in the Aadhaar
column. They fail checksum validation and should be cleared before the demo.
notes: Checksum-invalid Aadhaar. Rejecting it is correct precision behaviour.

subject: Form defaults
body: Several forms were submitted with 1111 1111 1111 typed into the Aadhaar field
as a placeholder. The data entry team has been told to leave it blank instead.

subject: Courier address correction
body: The courier has the wrong PIN code for the branch. It should be 560103, not
560013. Please update the address on the dispatch labels.

subject: Budget figures for the quarter
body: Capital budget 9845000000 rupees against a revised estimate of 8420000000.
The variance note is with finance. Board review is on the 30th.
notes: Ten-digit figures starting 9 and 8 look exactly like Indian mobile numbers.

subject: HIS release notes v2.14
body: Release v2.14 goes out this weekend. It includes fixes to the billing module
and the report scheduler. Known issue K21 in the tracker is deferred to v2.15.
notes: K21 without a decimal is a valid ICD-10 category code, but this is a bug tracker.

subject: Monitor model E11 quotation
body: The vendor has quoted for the E11 series patient monitors, twelve units.
Comparison with the J18 series from the other supplier is attached.
notes: E11 and J18 are real ICD-10 categories used here as equipment model numbers.

subject: Audit window
body: The internal audit covers 01/04/2025 to 31/03/2026. Departments should keep
their registers available for that period. Sampling starts next month.
notes: Dates that are not dates of birth.

subject: Contact for the new intranet
body: Queries about the new intranet should go to helpdesk@sunrisehospital.in rather
than to individual IT staff. The old alias stops working at the end of the month.
notes: An internal service address is not patient data; detecting it is harmless, treating it as PHI is not.

subject: Ward B12 stock of vitamin B12 in room A12
body: Deliberately awkward: ward B12 needs vitamin B12 stock delivered to room A12.
Housekeeping will move the trolley after the morning round.
notes: Three ICD-shaped tokens in one clean sentence.

subject: Serial numbers for warranty
body: Warranty claim needs the serial numbers: SN-4471982-KL and SN-4471983-KL.
Both units are from the same batch and failed within the warranty period.

subject: GST filing reference
body: The GST return acknowledgement reference is 174829105538 for last month.
Keep it with the filing records for the annual reconciliation.
notes: Twelve digits that are not an Aadhaar - checksum is the only thing separating them.

subject: Diagnosis coding training
body: Refresher training on diagnosis coding for the clinical coders.
We will cover the difference between principal and secondary diagnoses, and
common errors in coding diabetes and hypertension. No live records will be used.
notes: Maximum clinical vocabulary density with zero patient data.

subject: ABHA integration status
body: The ABHA integration is now live in registration. Health ID creation takes about
ninety seconds per patient. Training material is on the intranet.
notes: The trigger words are present with no identifier to attach them to.
